output.explanation: NIG-SA booked NIG-SA:ICV-SA-019030 at AED 15,960.00 against NIG-AE's invoice AE-ICINV-00837 (NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031401) of AED 16,800.00. The ratio is 0.95, which matches Saudi 5% WHT on services, and the buyer description explicitly states 'net of WHT 5%'. The AED 840.00 gap (USD 228.72) is the tax withheld; the counterparty and reference match, and both lines fall in the period.
output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should gross up the IC payable to AED 16,800 and credit a WHT payable to the Saudi tax authority for AED 840, then provide the WHT certificate to NIG-AE so it can reclassify the AED 840 receivable to a WHT receivable or tax expense.
output.adjustment_description: NIG-SA: debit IC payable reclass / increase IC payable to NIG-AE by AED 840 against a credit to WHT payable (ZATCA). NIG-AE: on receipt of the WHT certificate, credit IC receivable from NIG-SA by AED 840 and debit WHT recoverable or tax expense.
